productDecision: Reject the current Glukhar-on-Reserve Command Window shape. Vanilla Payback already contains the same command target on Reserve and requires successful Reserve extraction after a broader Glukhar/guards/flare sequence, so Admiral's narrower Glukhar plus successful extraction contract is a semantic subset rather than a distinct operation. Do not materialize it and do not preserve it merely to keep authored quest count. A replacement is admitted only if it has a distinct gameplay purpose and proven SPT 4.1.3 condition semantics.
whyThisTargetWasInitiallySelected: Glukhar is a literal command element with a coherent Reserve identity, so the objective matched Command Window better than an arbitrary boss selected only for difficulty.
A single boss target compressed legacy escalating boss/follower counters into one bounded operation.
Reserve has pinned exact quest-location authority as RezervBase.
The operation intentionally paid no boss gear or trophy reward, avoiding a boss-equipment faucet.

relevantShape: survive and extract from Reserve through Cliff Descent
vanilla.reason: Command Window currently asks for the same named boss on the same map followed by successful extraction. Payback adds guards, flare and a specific extract; those additions do not make the narrower Admiral contract independently valuable.

economyReview.reason: The previous reward envelope was bounded, but reward validity does not rescue a semantically duplicate objective. No reward is materialized while the target shape is rejected.

rejectedAlternatives: Glukhar on Reserve plus successful extraction because vanilla Payback is a semantic superset
keeping a duplicate boss quest only to preserve authored quest count
